info.name: Xcel Energy Green Button Connect My Data ApplicationInformation Batch API
Bulk Atom feed for a subscription

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Identifier of a Subscription created from an Authorization.

params.name: published-min
params.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the Atom entry published timestamp, in epoch seconds or ISO 8601.

params.name: published-max
params.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the Atom entry published timestamp, in epoch seconds or ISO 8601.

params.name: updated-min
params.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the Atom entry updated timestamp.

params.name: updated-max
params.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the Atom entry updated timestamp.

items.docs: Returns a Batch Atom feed containing all UsagePoint, MeterReading, IntervalBlock, ReadingType, ElectricPowerUsageSummary, and ElectricPowerQualitySummary entries authorized under the subscription, optionally filtered by published or updated time.

info.name: Bulk Atom feed for a single UsagePoint

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Identifier of a Subscription created from an Authorization.

params.name: usagePointId
params.description: Identifier of a UsagePoint within a Subscription.

params.name: published-min
params.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the Atom entry published timestamp, in epoch seconds or ISO 8601.

params.name: published-max
params.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the Atom entry published timestamp, in epoch seconds or ISO 8601.

items.docs: Returns a Batch Atom feed containing the resources associated with a single UsagePoint authorized under the subscription.

info.name: Bulk Atom feed for a retail customer

params.name: authorizationId
params.description: Identifier of an Authorization granted by a retail customer.

items.docs: Returns a Batch Atom feed containing the customer information resources for an authorized retail customer.
